106 likes, 0 comments - 91mobiles on October 8, 2026: "Which phones have the best battery life in 2026? We have an answer!

We tested smartphones across different price segments to find the ones that deliver the best endurance, based on our in-house battery tests and real-world usage.

From the OnePlus 15, our best overall battery phone, to the OPPO Find X9 Ultra, which leads the race among premium flagships. The Realme P4 Power is the best in the mid-range segment, while the Redmi Note 17 Pro Max delivered the highest PCMark Battery Drain score we have recorded at 24 hours.

People who favour iPhones and want the best battery life possible? The iPhone 18 Pro Max is undoubtedly the top choice.

Read the full story for our testing results and detailed reasons as to why each phone won. [link in bio]".

1,724 likes, 28 comments - 91mobiles on October 6, 2026: "The iPhone 18 Pro Max has arrived, but is it actually the best camera phone among the latest flagship competition? We put it up against the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra and Google Pixel 11 Pro XL to find out.

Across daylight, 5x zoom, ultrawide, portraits, selfies and low-light shots, each phone had its own strengths.

The Galaxy S26 Ultra ultimately came out on top for its consistent output, while the Pixel 11 Pro XL won us over with its natural colours and zoom performance. The iPhone 18 Pro Max, meanwhile, was the clear winner for portraits.

Read our full comparison to see how all three phones performed in each scenario. (Link in bio)

So, which smartphone would you pick if the camera is your priority? Choose your favourite in the poll below!".
